title: Narrative
summary: NARRATIVE, adjective 1. Relating the particulars of an event or transaction; giving a particular or continued account. 2. Apt or inclined to relate stories, or to tell particulars of events; story-tel

inlines.v: NARRATIVE, adjective 1. Relating the particulars of an event or transaction; giving a particular or continued account. 2. Apt or inclined to relate stories, or to tell particulars of events; story-telling. But wise through time and narrative with age. NARRATIVE, noun The recital of a story, or a continued account of the particulars of an event or transaction; story. Cynthio was much taken with my narrative
